AddCategory.description_en: Creates a category in a specified workspace to classify and manage files. Each workspace supports a maximum of 500 categories
AddCategory.description_zh: 在指定的业务空间中创建一个类目，用于分类和管理文件。每个业务空间最多创建500个类目

AddChunk.description_en: Adds chunks to a document search (document), data query (table), or image Q&A (image) knowledge base
AddChunk.description_zh: 使用此API可为文档搜索类（document）、数据查询类（table）、图片问答类（image）知识库添加切片

AddConnector.description_en: Creates a connector. This API currently supports only file connectors
AddConnector.description_zh: 创建连接器，当前接口仅支持创建文件类型连接器

AddFile.description_en: Imports a file from the temporary storage of Alibaba Cloud Model Studio into an Alibaba Cloud Model Studio data connection (formerly known as application data)
AddFile.description_zh: 将存储于阿里云百炼临时存储空间内的文件导入至阿里云百炼数据连接（原应用数据）

AddFilesFromAuthorizedOss.description_en: Imports files from an authorized OSS bucket into Alibaba Cloud Model Studio application data
AddFilesFromAuthorizedOss.description_zh: 将已授权OSS Bucket中的文件导入阿里云百炼应用数据中

AddTable.description_en: Add a table for the table data connector
AddTable.description_zh: 为表格数据连接器添加表格

ApplyFileUploadLease.description_en: Request an upload lease for uploading knowledge base files or files for agent application conversational interactions
ApplyFileUploadLease.description_zh: 请求一个上传租约用于上传知识库文件，或智能体应用会话交互的文件

ApplyTempStorageLease.description_en: This interface is intended for pro-code deployment only; other scenarios are currently not supported. It is used to apply for a temporary file upload lease. After obtaining the lease, you must upload the file manually
ApplyTempStorageLease.description_zh: 该接口用于高代码部署，其他场景暂不支持。用于申请临时文件上传许可，之后需要自己完成文件上传动作

BatchUpdateFileTag.description_en: This operation updates document tags in a data connection in batches
BatchUpdateFileTag.description_zh: 该接口用于批量更新数据连接中的文档标签

ChangeParseSetting.description_en: Configures the parsing method for specific file types. For example, specifies large model document parsing for .pdf files or Qwen VL parsing for .jpg files
ChangeParseSetting.description_zh: 配置特定文件类型的解析方式。例如，为 .pdf 文件指定使用大模型文档解析，为 .jpg 文件指定使用Qwen VL解析

CreateIndex.description_en: Creates a knowledge base of either type: an unstructured knowledge base based on documents or audio/video, or a structured knowledge base for data queries or image-based Q&A
CreateIndex.description_zh: 使用此API可创建两类知识库：基于文档或音视频的非结构化知识库，以及用于数据查询或图片问答的结构化知识库

DeleteCategory.description_zh: 永久性删除指定的类目

DeleteChunk.description_en: Deletes specified text chunks from a knowledge base. Deleted text chunks cannot be retrieved or recalled
DeleteChunk.description_zh: 删除知识库中的指定文本切片，被删的文本切片将无法被检索和召回

DeleteFile.description_en: Permanently delete a specified file from application data. Deleting data tables via API is not supported. For details, see the API Guide below
DeleteFile.description_zh: 永久删除应用数据中的指定文件。不支持通过API删除数据表，详见下方接口说明

DeleteIndex.description_en: Permanently deletes a specified knowledge base
DeleteIndex.description_zh: 永久性删除指定的知识库

DeleteIndexDocument.description_en: Permanently deletes files from a specified knowledge base
DeleteIndexDocument.description_zh: 永久删除指定知识库中的文件

DeleteMemory.description_en: Permanently deletes a specified long-term memory
DeleteMemory.description_zh: 永久性删除指定的长期记忆体

DeletePromptTemplate.description_en: Deletes a prompt template based on the template ID

DescribeFile.description_en: Queries the basic information of a file in application data, including the file name, type, and status
DescribeFile.description_zh: 查询应用数据中文件的基本信息，包括文件名称、类型、状态等

GetAlipayTransferStatus.description_en: Queries the tipping status of the Alipay wallet bound to an application
GetAlipayTransferStatus.description_zh: 查询应用中绑定的支付宝钱包的打赏状态

GetAlipayUrl.description_en: Retrieves the Alipay tipping URL for an application
GetAlipayUrl.description_zh: 获取应用上支付宝的打赏链接

GetAvailableParserTypes.description_en: Lists all supported parser types based on the input file type (file extension)
GetAvailableParserTypes.description_zh: 根据输入的文件类型（文件扩展名），获取所有支持的解析器类型列表

GetConnector.description_en: Retrieves details about a connector. This operation currently supports only file connectors
GetConnector.description_zh: 获取连接器信息。当前接口仅支持获取文件连接器信息

GetIndexJobStatus.description_en: Queries the current status of a specified knowledge base creation task or knowledge base document append task
GetIndexJobStatus.description_zh: 查询指定的知识库创建任务或知识库追加任务的当前状态

GetIndexMonitor.description_en: You can call the GetIndexMonitor operation to query monitoring data for a specified knowledge base within a specific time range. This data is crucial for App Performance Analytics, capacity planning, and cost management. The monitoring data includes two main dimensions: storage and retrieval. Storage monitoring retrieves the index storage limit and current usage of the knowledge base. Retrieval monitoring retrieves performance metrics for the query period, such as peak queries per second (QPS), total requests, and average QPS. The metrics are provided as totals and are also broken down by time window. The requests are categorized as successful, failed, and rate-limited
GetIndexMonitor.description_zh:
调用GetIndexMonitor接口，查询指定知识库在特定时间范围内的监控数据。这些数据对于性能分析、容量规划和成本管理至关重要。

监控数据主要包含两大维度：

存储监控：获取知识库的索引存储限额和当前使用量。
检索（QPS）监控：获取查询时间段内总的及按时间窗口细分的检索性能指标，包括QPS峰值、总请求数、平均QPS，并细分为成功、失败和被限流的请求

GetMemory.description_en: Retrieves the description of a specified long-term memory
GetMemory.description_zh: 获取指定长期记忆体的描述信息

GetParseSettings.description_en: Queries the data parsing settings in a specified category
GetParseSettings.description_zh: 查询指定类目的数据解析设置

GetPromptTemplate.description_en: Obtains a prompt template based on the template ID

ListCategory.description_en: Retrieves the details of one or more categories in a specified workspace
ListCategory.description_zh: 获取指定业务空间下一个或多个类目的详细信息

ListChunks.description_en: Queries the list and information of text chunks
ListChunks.description_zh: 查看文本切片列表及信息

ListFile.description_en: Retrieves the details of one or more documents in a specified category
ListFile.description_zh: 获取指定类目下一个或多个文档的详细信息

ListIndexDocuments.description_en: Retrieves files and their summary information from a specified knowledge base
ListIndexDocuments.description_zh: 获取指定知识库中的文件，以及它们的概要信息

ListIndexFileDetails.description_en: Retrieves files and their details from a specified knowledge base
ListIndexFileDetails.description_zh: 获取指定知识库中的文件，以及它们的详细信息

ListIndices.description_en: Retrieves the list of knowledge bases in a specified workspace
ListIndices.description_zh: 获取指定业务空间下知识库列表

ListMemories.description_en: Retrieves the details of one or more long-term memory entities in a specified workspace
ListMemories.description_zh: 获取指定业务空间下一个或多个长期记忆体的详细信息

ListMemoryNodes.description_en: Retrieves a list of memory nodes

ListPromptTemplates.description_en: Obtains a list of prompt templates

Retrieve.description_en: Retrieves information from a specified knowledge base
Retrieve.description_zh: 在指定的知识库中检索信息

SubmitIndexAddDocumentsJob.description_en: Appends parsed files to a specified knowledge base
SubmitIndexAddDocumentsJob.description_zh: 向指定知识库中追加导入已解析的文件

SubmitIndexJob.description_en: Submits a specified CreateIndex task to complete knowledge base creation
SubmitIndexJob.description_zh: 提交指定的 CreateIndex 任务以完成知识库创建

UpdateChunk.description_en: Modifies the content and title of a specified text chunk in a knowledge base, and specifies whether the chunk participates in knowledge base retrieval
UpdateChunk.description_zh: 修改知识库中指定文本切片的内容（content）和标题（title），并设置是否参与知识库检索

UpdateFileTag.description_en: Updates the tags for a specified file

UpdateIndex.description_en: Updates the configuration of a specified knowledge base
UpdateIndex.description_zh: 更新指定知识库的部分配置

UpdateMemory.description_en: Updates the description of a specified long-term memory
UpdateMemory.description_zh: 更新指定长期记忆体的描述信息

UpdatePromptTemplate.description_en: Updates a prompt template based on the template ID
UpdatePromptTemplate.description_zh: 基于模板Id增量更新Prompt模板

UpdateTableFromAuthorizedOss.description_en: Update a table in an Alibaba Cloud Model Studio data connector using a file from an authorized OSS bucket
UpdateTableFromAuthorizedOss.description_zh: 使用已授权OSS Bucket中的文件更新阿里云百炼数据连接中表格连接器中的表格
